_doc: Golden renders of the djust.components.ui simple components (#4002). The 15 classes the retired Rust crate drew were captured from it before it was removed (slice 1); Alert, Badge, Button, Card, Dropdown, Modal, Progress and Spinner now draw their ui *Component twin's markup (slice 3, recaptured). 'fix' entries differ from 'rust_html' on purpose. See python/tests/test_ui_simple_golden_4002.py.
